subject: Mutual Action Plan + Onramp: hosting options, eval timeline, and geo constraints
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Simone Roder <s.roder@helixtech.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: quick onramp checklist + hosting tradeoffs

Hi Simone —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I attached a draft MAP that lays out the evaluation milestones, responsibilities, and a proposed close timeline so we can pick a production path (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). High-level notes here: 

- Goal: Small PoC (week-long) -> 30-day eval -> production pilot.
- Tradeoffs we need your alignment on:
  * Hosted: fastest to start, lower up-front cost, data routed through Redwood hosted endpoints (we can scope logging retention).
  * Dedicated: reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput; good if you need consistent latency and want capacity isolation.
  * Private (VPC/on-prem): for full data residency and stricter controls; longer setup (network, KMS).

Can you confirm the procurement constraint you mentioned (data residency in US-East) and whether the security review needs SOC 2 evidence before the PoC? That will affect whether we start Hosted (with region lock) or go straight to Dedicated/Private.

Attached: Helix_MAP_v3.xlsx — I filled in dates for a June-style sprint but we can compress. Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm residency/SOC ask by EOD Tue (8/24)
2) We run a short benchmark (3 days) in US-East (hosted) while legal/procurement review Dedicated/Private terms
3) Sync: Thu 8/26 — align on final production lane

If this looks good I’ll loop in Karthik (SE) and Laura (Solutions) to prep benchmarks and a lightweight security packet.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Helix_MAP_v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Simone Roder <s.roder@helixtech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Gold <egold@helixtech.com>, HelixTech Procurement <procurement@helixtech.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: quick onramp checklist + hosting tradeoffs

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the clear MAP. Quick answers:

- Residency: must be US data only for the PoC and production. US-East preferred, US-West acceptable.
- SOC 2: Our security team wants SOC 2 Type II evidence before committing to Dedicated or Private. For the PoC they said hosted is OK if logs/audit controls can be scoped and contractually limited.
- Procurement: we need an estimated TCO for both Dedicated (monthly commitment) and Hosted (bursting + tokens) to include in our procurement packet.

We can confirm formally after our internal legal sync tomorrow morning; I expect a response by EOD 8/24. In the meantime, can Karthik share the benchmark plan and expected latency figures for a 2k qps synthetic test?

Best,
Simone
Director, Platform — HelixTech

Hi Simone / team —

Thanks for the fast reply. Per your asks:

- SOC 2 evidence: we will share a sanitized SOC 2 packet and an operational controls summary by EOD 8/24. That should satisfy your security gate for evaluating Dedicated vs Private; if procurement needs the full report we can coordinate redaction/NDAs.
- Benchmark plan (short): see bullets below — Karthik will own execution.

Proposed lightweight eval plan (compressible):
- Day 0: kickoff + network checks (choose US-East endpoint)
- Day 1–2: baseline synthetic run (2k qps synthetic, 95th latency targets) — hosted US-East
- Day 3: prefix/KV caching check + model config tuning
- Day 4: wrap + scorecard + recommendation (hosted -> production reserve OR dedicated trial)

Decision gates we expect from Helix:
1) Residency ok for hosted PoC (yes/no)
2) Will procurement accept provisional Hosted SLA while they review Dedicated/Private costs?

If you’d like, we can run the PoC on Hosted US-East and simultaneously queue a Dedicated capacity estimate; that minimizes time to data while giving procurement numbers.

I’ll attach the SOC2 summary and the benchmark template in a follow-up.

Cheers,
Vanessa

- Karthik: can you prepare the 2k qps synthetic benchmark plan (script, dataset, expected 95th latency, token cost estimates) and a short pdf with latency/cost tradeoffs? Need this by EOD 8/24 so I can send to procurement.

- Markus: heads-up — we may need a small credit concession if procurement presses on TCO for initial pilot.

Goal: run Hosted PoC in US-East on Tue 8/25 if procurement gives provisional sign-off. If not, we may need to accelerate Dedicated pricing.

All — attaching the benchmark notes and a short recommendation doc. TL;DR: for speed to insight start with Hosted in US-East for the PoC, run the 2k qps synthetic (we expect p95 ~120–160 ms for the curated 7B variant), then follow with a Dedicated capacity estimate for the pilot if latency variance exceeds their SLO.

Key items attached:
- helix_benchmark_notes.pdf (includes test harness, cost projection for Hosted vs 1x Dedicated pool, and model quantization suggestion)
- Quick recommendation: Start Hosted PoC 8/25–8/28; procurement collects TCO using the attached estimate; target decision for pilot lane by 9/02.

Suggested mutual action plan milestones (from notes):
- 8/25: Hosted PoC run (US-East) — Karthik executes; Vanessa sends results to Simone + procurement
- 8/26–8/27: Procurement review / SOC2 packet review (Laura owner)
- 9/01: Cross-functional checkpoint — finalize lane (Hosted reserve vs Dedicated commit)
- 9/02: Sign-off and purchase order or pilot commitment

If procurement pushes for Private straightaway, timeline slides 2–3 weeks for VPC setup + KMS.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
